LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD appears legitimate and follows standard Arch packaging practices for a binary release package. The `source` URLs are correctly constructed using the `pkgver` variable to fetch releases from the official GitHub repository (https://github.com/kryptic-sh/hjkl/releases/download/v${pkgver}/...). The SHA256 checksums are provided for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, allowing verification of the downloaded binaries.

The `package()` function performs standard installation operations typical of binary packages - installing the hjkl binary to /usr/bin/, and documentation files (LICENSE, README.md) to their standard locations. There are no suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, or unusual file operations in the global scope or pkgver() function. The PKGBUILD is properly formatted and references the upstream project correctly.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>Binary release package with properly verifiable sources</summary>
</security_assessment>
